text: ITEM 1 | Whole oval nut-like pieces, tan to medium brown with slightly darker edges and a smooth, papery skin, some with a paler cream-colored patch on one end, each about 2 to 2.5 cm long and 1.2 to 1.5 cm wide, pointed at one end, dry and firm, not glossy, scattered in a loose cluster across the lower-left and center of a white paper plate about 20 cm across, covering roughly 40 percent of the plate surface, piled only one layer high (about 1.2 cm tall) | 35
